title: Quantum Optical Techniques for Biomedical Imaging
summary: Review of quantum optical imaging techniques (QOCT, sub-shot-noise imaging, entangled multiphoton microscopy, ghost imaging, multi-parameter imaging). Most at TRL 2-4 (proof-of-concept). Photon pair rates 10^5-10^7/s vs classical 10^13-10^15/s — orders of magnitude slower, limiting practical throughput. No neural/BCI applications discussed.
bci_relevance: Quantum optical imaging for BCIs is not viable on <$20k budget and not near-term. Throughput penalty (8 orders of magnitude) eliminates real-time neural imaging application. WATCH only.
independent_researcher_budget: Not feasible. Entangled photon sources ~$50k+, SPAD arrays ~$20k+. Not in scope.
